placements.title: Immediate-Return Receipts and Decoupled Polling Replace Blocking Execution
placements.frame: How does the async job contract handle request dispatch and progress tracking without blocking clients or risking dropped work?
placements.why: Captures the ratified architectural decision that remember calls return receipts immediately while long-running extraction is monitored via cursor polling or piggybacked reactions, preventing blocking calls and safeguarding against lost work.
